headline: Germany's IG Metall Union Launches Warning Strikes Over Pay
summary: Members of Germany's IG Metall trade union launched warning strikes in the metalworking and electrical sectors seeking better pay and job guarantees.
why: IG Metall is Germany's largest and most powerful industrial union, and its labor negotiations often set wage trends across Europe's largest manufacturing economy, impacting corporate margins.

impacts.name: German metalworking and electrical sectors
impacts.why: Warning strikes directly disrupt manufacturing operations and signal potential labor costs pressures.
